task_semantics: Standard CVRP: no fixed fleet size, num_available=n_customers, zero fixed vehicle cost. Not the old at-most-K_ref derived panel.
limitations: Standard X CVRP differs from the previous derived at-most-K_ref small panel; no scale-only causal attribution.
This 12-task metadata-selected panel does not establish general CVRP performance, SOTA, universal superiority or statistical significance.
No historical TSR outputs exist for this large panel, so there is no large-panel TSR comparison.
Public catalog and reference values may be known to researchers; this is neither strictly blind nor preregistered confirmatory research.
Reference feasibility is verified; no optimality proof is established here.
Wall-time stopping is sensitive to machine speed and load. Fixed seeds do not ensure bitwise repeatability.
The one-second search stop does not include initialization or model construction. Configured guard sums are not measured end-to-end resources.
The Python audit hook does not prove zero native IO.
The private external wheel archive is a required restoration dependency, identified by exact Drive ID, archive hash, transport-part hashes and wheel-member hashes.
